full_text:
A Ghost Trap is a type of magical, Casterwill family trap that leaves behind a green, ghostly version of the Seeker who summoned it. Two Ghost Traps were left to guard the Mausoleum of Sir Lancelot, one by Sir Lancelot himself and another in the image of Guinevere, his lover. 

== History ==
Two Ghost Traps were left Sir Lancelot and Guinevere guard the Mausoleum of Sir Lancelot. The trap of Lancelot was activated by Dante Vale and Lok Lambert during their mission, The Mausoleum of Sir Lancelot. The Ghost Trap attacked and overpowered the two but, covertly, was dispatched by Rassimov's Hopeshatter spell. Later, Dante and Lok encountered the Ghost Trap of Guinevere. By kissing her hand, Guinevere let them pass. [Memory Lane]

== Abilities ==
The Ghost Trap was extremely skilled in melee combat with formidable use of its sword and shield.
